provenance.notes: Our contribution: the 6x14 pair-closed template (7 column pairs, every block row the union of 4 pairs, design rate 1/7), chosen because a typical-distance estimate of the LDPC ensemble with its column-degree mix (the Gallager weight-distribution estimate; Gallager, Low-Density Parity-Check Codes, MIT Press 1963) put rate 1/7 at the best ratio of predicted distance to the distance a rate-1/7 code needs; the search for its pairings (our couple solver, a search for pairings whose exponent equations keep free dimensions, run under one cyclic symmetry of the template at a time; this pairing is one of the solutions with 3 free exponent dimensions of one template class); the lift N = 71 and this exponent draw; and the distance screening. Construction framework, not ours: the pair-partition construction and its paired-difference equations on CPM exponents are Okada and Kasai's (arXiv:2607.14091); the design-rate count R = 1 - J_tot/L_stab and the permanent-vector upper bound used to rank templates (App. A of arXiv:2609.30069) are from Lee, Okada, Maskara, Kasai and Zhou (arXiv:2609.30069); quasi-cyclic CSS LDPC codes from circulant permutation matrices go back to Hagiwara and Imai (arXiv:quant-ph/0701020), and CSS pairs of two irregular LDPC codes were analysed by Hagiwara and Imai (arXiv:0801.1361). Board precedents of the same commutation rule at weight 8: codes/996-166-36.json by @jacksongquera and our codes/996-166-32.json and codes/996-166-34.json (irregular 5x12 template, rate 1/6), codes/912-234-22.json by @jacksongquera and codes/904-230-22.json by @vprusso (complete (3,8) template). Literature novelty is not claimed. Distance: a witness-backed upper bound (confidence upper_bound), d <= 40 (filed witnesses: X weight 41, Z weight 40; a weight-40 X logical seen in one run was not saved); nothing lighter in about 15.4 independent CPU-hours of Stern-type information-set decoding on both sides (39 runs in all, 21.4 CPU-hours; 15.4 after counting runs that repeat a seed in the second program once; two separate programs, our isd_fast with collision windows 16 and 14 and our isd_trace), lightest per side over all runs X 40, Z 40. No lower bound is claimed, so the true distance and score may be lower. Details in notes/994-142-40.md.
